title: Cabinetmakers and Bench Carpenters
description: Cut, shape, and assemble wooden articles or set up and operate a variety of woodworking machines, such as power saws, jointers, and mortisers to surface, cut, or shape lumber or to fabricate parts for wood products.

tasks.text: Verify dimensions or check the quality or fit of pieces to ensure adherence to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Produce or assemble components of articles, such as store fixtures, office equipment, cabinets, or high-grade furniture.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

dwas.name: Assemble wood products.

tasks.text: Trim, sand, or scrape surfaces or joints to prepare articles for finishing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Measure and mark dimensions of parts on paper or lumber stock prior to cutting, following blueprints, to ensure a tight fit and quality product.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Cut timber to the right size, and shape and trim parts of joints to ensure a snug fit, using hand tools, such as planes, chisels, or wood files.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.
Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Match materials for color, grain, or texture, giving attention to knots or other features of the wood.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vision AI assists but physical comparison is human

dwas.name: Compare physical characteristics of materials or products to specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Set up or operate machines, including power saws, jointers, mortisers, tenoners, molders, or shapers, to cut, mold, or shape woodstock or wood substitutes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Woodworking equipment needs dexterity and material feel

dwas.name: Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Establish the specifications of articles to be constructed or repaired, or plan the methods or operations for shaping or assembling parts, based on blueprints, drawings, diagrams, or oral or written instructions.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Bore holes for insertion of screws or dowels, by hand or using boring machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Attach parts or subassemblies together to form completed units, using glue, dowels, nails, screws, or clamps.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

dwas.name: Assemble wood products.

tasks.text: Reinforce joints with nails or other fasteners to prepare articles for finishing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

dwas.name: Assemble wood products.

tasks.text: Install hardware, such as hinges, handles, catches, or drawer pulls, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching accessories requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Attach decorative or functional accessories to products.

tasks.text: Perform final touch-ups with sandpaper or steel wool.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Shaping wood edges requires hands-on tools

dwas.name: Shape surfaces or edges of wood workpieces.

tasks.text: Repair or alter wooden furniture, cabinetry, fixtures, paneling, or other pieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

dwas.name: Repair furniture or upholstery.

tasks.text: Design furniture, using computer-aided drawing programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids furniture concepts; ergonomics and fabrication human

dwas.name: Operate computers or computerized equipment.
Design furniture.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Program computers to operate machinery.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Dip, brush, or spray assembled articles with protective or decorative finishes, such as stain, varnish, paint, or lacquer.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Draw up detailed specifications and discuss projects with customers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order spec negotiation with customers is relational

dwas.name: Confer with customers or designers to determine order specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Estimate the amounts, types, or costs of needed materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost estimation from inputs; human validates

dwas.name: Estimate costs of products, services, or materials.
Estimate material requirements for production.

tasks.text: Apply Masonite, formica, or vinyl surfacing materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.
